# Assumptions: walking_steps

12 confirmed · 15 assumed · 2 open

## Confirmed (12)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device.bout_need` | `8` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: a bout is established when 8 of 10 minutes are at or above the cutpoint |  |
| `device.bout_stop_below` | `3` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: the bout stops when 3 minutes in the 10-minute window are below the cutpoint |  |
| `device.bout_window` | `10` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: MV bout rolling window of 10 minutes |  |
| `device.interrupt_ceiling` | `100` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: interruptions have counts < 100 |  |
| `device.interrupt_minutes` | `2` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: interruptions of up to 2 consecutive minutes |  |
| `device.light_floor` | `100` | Troiano 2008 light intensity 100-2019 counts/min, as in the release |  |
| `device.max_valid_days` | `7` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: only the first 7 valid days are used |  |
| `device.min_valid_days` | `4` | Accelerometry_Descrip.pdf: 4-7 valid days |  |
| `device.mv_cutpoint` | `2020` | Troiano 2008 cutpoint, as in the release |  |
| `device.nonwear_minutes` | `90` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf (non-wear >90 zero minutes); >= 90 within each calendar day reproduces the release's by-day files | Validated for knee-OA wear patterns; 60 is the NHANES rule |
| `device.valid_day_hours` | `10.0` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: valid day = >= 10 wear hours |  |
| `steps.day_rule` | `complete` (choices: complete) | User decision 2026-11-12 (oai.derive.accel.step_day_usable) | A valid day with any wear minute lacking steps is left out of the step analysis; 4 valid days across both waves are partly missing. Days are still chosen by wear alone. |

## Assumed (15)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device.purposeful_bout_minutes` | `10` | Spec 5: purposeful walking proxy = minutes in >= 10-minute MV bouts |  |
| `pase.device_pairing` | `adjacent_wave` (choices: adjacent_wave, two_wave_mean) | As walking_validation pase.device_pairing: PASE at 48 and 72 months against the same visit's device wave; PASE at 96 months against the mean over valid waves |  |
| `pase.frequent_days_code` | `2` (choices: 1, 2, 3) | As walking_validation components.pase_frequency_cuts: PASE item 2 days code >= 2 = walking on at least 3-4 days | A frequency-restricted PASE walker, reported beside 'any walking'. |
| `pase.visits` | `["06", "08", "10"]` | PASE at 48, 72 and 96 months: the two device waves and the visit of the walking question |  |
| `pase.walker_threshold` | `0.0` | As walking_validation: a PASE walker reports any walking outside the home in the past 7 days (subscore > 0) |  |
| `pase.walking_scoring` | `{"days": [0.0, 1.5, 3.5, 6.0], "hours": [0.5, 1.5, 3.0, 5.0], "weight": 20.0}` | Washburn et al. 1993 PASE scoring for item 2 (walking outside the home), as walking_validation |  |
| `reference.min_bout_days_per_week` | `2.0` | As walking_validation reference.min_bout_days_per_week (device habitual walker = >= 2 bout-days per valid week) |  |
| `reference.min_bout_minutes_per_week` | `150.0` | As walking_validation reference.min_bout_minutes_per_week (DHHS 2008 aerobic guideline volume) |  |
| `reference.step_cadences` | `[40, 60, 100]` | Step walking bouts at three cadences: 40 (this ledger's walking minute), 60 (lowest NHANES walking band) and 100 steps/min (moderate intensity; Tudor-Locke & Rowe 2012) | Every cadence is reported beside the count-based MV bouts, so no single step definition is built in. |
| `sample.min_step_days` | `4` (choices: 1, 4) | Mirrors device.min_valid_days: a person counts when at least this many of their first valid days have complete steps | Keeps the per-person shares on the same footing as the release's valid-person rule. |
| `validity.auc_measures` | `["counts_per_day", "mv_min", "purposeful_min", "steps", "peak_cadence", "cadence40_min", "cadence60_min", "cadence100_min", "step_bout40_min", "step_bout60_min", "step_bout100_min"]` | Every continuous count and step measure: AUC for each yes/no self-report, Spearman with the PASE walking subscore |  |
| `validity.bootstrap_reps` | `1000` | As walking_validation validity.bootstrap_reps (AUC percentile bootstrap, stratified by self-report) |  |
| `validity.seed` | `20261112` | Fixed seed for the AUC bootstrap |  |
| `walking.band_edges` | `[1, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120]` | 20-step bands: Tudor-Locke & Rowe 2012's 60-79 to 120+ bands, with 1-59 split at 20 and 40 | Lower edges of the cadence bands in cadence_bands.csv; 0 steps is its own band. |
| `walking.cadences` | `[1, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100]` | Tudor-Locke & Rowe 2012 (Sports Med 42:381, doi:10.2165/11599170-000000000-00000): NHANES cadence bands 0, 1-59, 60-79, 80-99, 100-119, 120+; 100 steps/min ~ moderate intensity (>= 3 METs). 20 and 40 split the 1-59 band | Every share is reported at each threshold, so no single definition of a walking minute is built into the outputs. |

## Open (2)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `exposure.yes_without_amount_as` | `non-walker` (choices: walker, non-walker, exclude) | As walking_validation exposure.yes_without_amount_as (reproduces Lo 2022's 887 walkers); question for the original authors in TODO.md |  |
| `walking.primary_cadence` | `40` (choices: 40, 60, 100) | No published threshold for a walking minute; 60 = the lowest NHANES walking band and 100 = moderate intensity (Tudor-Locke & Rowe 2012). 40 is this ledger's choice, to allow for minutes only partly spent walking | The threshold used for the headline sentence in WALKING_SHARE.md. A minute only partly spent walking shows a diluted cadence (30 s at 100 steps/min records 50 steps), so higher thresholds understate walking. |

## Variants

| Variant | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `any_step_day` | `sample.min_step_days = 1` | Count a person with at least one complete step day |
| `pase_two_wave_mean` | `pase.device_pairing = two_wave_mean` | Every PASE visit against the mean over valid device waves |
| `primary_cadence_100` | `walking.primary_cadence = 100` | Headline walking minute = >= 100 steps/min (moderate intensity) |
| `primary_cadence_60` | `walking.primary_cadence = 60` | Headline walking minute = >= 60 steps/min (slow walking) |
| `yes_without_amount_as_walker` | `exposure.yes_without_amount_as = walker` | A 96-month 'yes' with no amount answers counts as a walker |
